
IF macOS BLOCKS THE INSTALLER ("cannot be opened" / "unidentified developer")
  This build is not yet notarized by Apple. To install it anyway:
  1. Double-click the .pkg once and close the warning.
  2. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click
     "Open Anyway" next to TrapWin_Limiter...pkg, then confirm.
  3. Manual install: if your DAW does not load the plugin, open Terminal and run
       sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/TrapLimit.vst3
       sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/TrapLimit.component

  CESKY: macOS blokuje instalator -> Nastaveni systemu > Soukromi a zabezpeceni >
  "Presto otevrit" u TrapWin_Limiter...pkg.
